# `@grow-codes/__KEY__` — agent quickstart (TypeScript)

Ships inside the npm package (`node_modules/@grow-codes/__KEY__/AGENTS.md`). Use it instead of reading
the package source. Full docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/__KEY__/ · Service:
__DISPLAY__ · Categories: __CATEGORIES__.

```sh
npm i @grow-codes/__KEY__        # Node >= 22.12; ESM and CommonJS
```

## Client

```ts
import { __SERVICE__Client, __SERVICE__Config, isGrowError } from "@grow-codes/__KEY__";
const client = __SERVICE__Client.fromEnv();        // GROW___KEY_UPPER___* > vendor env > defaults
await client.health();                             // never throws for a down service
await client.close();                              // idempotent; flushes batches
```

Config precedence: explicit option > `GROW___KEY_UPPER___<NAME>` > vendor variables > default. Common names:
`URL`, `TOKEN`, `CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `REQUEST_TIMEOUT`, `TOTAL_TIMEOUT`, `MAX_RETRIES`, `CA_CERT`, `PROXY`.
Errors: `__SERVICE__Error` with `code` (`CONFIG`, `AUTHENTICATION`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `CONFLICT`,
`RATE_LIMITED`, `VALIDATION`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `TIMEOUT`, `UNSUPPORTED`, `CANCELLED`), `retryable`, `httpStatus`.
Branch on `code`, never on the message. Credentials are `Secret`; never log `reveal()` results.

## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```ts
import { loadConfig } from "@grow-codes/__KEY__";
await loadConfig({ required: ["DATABASE_URL", "JWT_SECRET"] }); // before anything reads process.env
```

- `loadConfig(opts?: { required?: string[]; into?: "env" | "none"; override?: boolean; path?: string;
  env?: Record<string, string | undefined>; connect?: SecretsConnector }): Promise<Record<string, string>>`
- Reads the platform bootstrap `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `__KEY__`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`, `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH` (`approle` → login with
  `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`GROW_SECRETS_SECRET_ID`), reads every key under `GROW_SECRETS_PATH` and writes them
  into `process.env` (secrets service wins, `GROW_SECRETS_*` untouched). Missing `required` keys →
  `NotFoundError` naming them (names only).
- No bootstrap (local dev) → reads nothing, checks `required` against `process.env`.
- `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1` (grow-secrets-exec already loaded the env) → reads nothing, checks `required`.
- Also: `loadConfigFrom(provider, opts)`, `readSecretsBootstrap(env)`, `secretsPreloaded(env)`.
- Provider API: `client.secrets()` → `get/getString/getJson/getNumber/getBool` (missing → `null`), `require`,
  `exists`, `getMany`, `getAll(path)`, `list`, `set`, `delete`, `metadata`, `loadEnv`, `watch`; `SecretCache`.

## Logging: one call

```ts
import { initLogging, requestLogger } from "@grow-codes/__KEY__";
const { logger, flush, close, canary } = initLogging({ service: "orders" }); // after loadConfig()
logger.info("started", { port: 3000 });
app.use(requestLogger());                    // Express / NestJS: x-request-id + "request completed"
process.on("SIGTERM", () => void close());
```

- `initLogging(opts?: { service?: string; level?: string; stdout?: boolean; ship?: boolean;
  redaction?: RedactionOptions }): LoggingHandle` — idempotent per process (`getLogging()` returns it).
- Always writes JSON lines to stdout: `time`, `level`, `msg`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`,
  `trace_id`, `span_id`, attributes (redacted). When `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=__KEY__` it also ships through
  this package (config from `GROW___KEY_UPPER___*`) and marks lines `log_shipped:"sdk"`; records the SDK
  could not export are re-emitted with `log_shipped:"sdk_failed"`. Never throws for a down service.
- Service name: `GROW_SERVICE_NAME` > `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`; environment: `GROW_ENVIRONMENT`; level: `LOG_LEVEL`.
- Handle: `logger` (`trace…fatal(message, attributes?)`, `child(attrs)`), `logs` (SDK `LogClient` or
  `undefined`), `shipped`, `flush(timeoutMs?)`, `close()`, `canary(message, attrs?)` (SDK only),
  `pinoStream()` (pass to `pino(opts, stream)`).
- `withRequestId(id, fn)`, `currentRequestId()`; pino/winston transports: `createPinoTransport(logs)`,
  `new WinstonTransport({ client: logs })`.
